title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own Aurevia’s CAD engine.
 



  





 Aurevia turns a jewellery photograph into a manufacturing\\-ready parametric CAD model watertight, dimensioned in real millimetres, castable in an actual lost\\-wax workflow. The engine runs on one rule: AI decides what to build, deterministic code builds the exact geometry. Models are excellent at reading a reference and inferring intent (four\\-prong cathedral, 2\\.1mm band, oval centre). They’re terrible at emitting geometry, they produce shapes that look right and are dimensionally wrong, which is worthless to a foundry. So no model ever touches a vertex. Everything past the spec is CSG booleans, sweeps and manufacturability checks in TypeScript and WASM. If you have real computational geometry chops, an instinct for numerical robustness, and you’d rather write the code than prompt for it, this is engineer \\#1 on the hardest part of the product. You don’t need a jewellery background; nobody here started with one. Please reach out for the full JD.
